title: Gemma 4 E2B/E4B QAT, safety geometry, transfer, composition, and lifecycle frontier
question: What additional Gemma 4 E2B and E4B evidence survives causal separation across QAT, PTQ, runtime, refusal scoring, multilingual safety, distillation, low-resource adaptation, modality composition, stripping, export, context, privacy, tool-schema drift, and MTP lifecycle stages?

inclusion_criteria: Exact Gemma 4 E2B or E4B source with an official topology, measured outcome, retained artifact, reproducible method, operational correction, or bounded negative search.
Evidence that exposes a denominator, scorer, teacher/data lineage, topology, export, runtime, modality, context, safety, or paired-artifact control.
Weak and private artifacts retained only when they expose a useful route or missing acceptance boundary.
Repeated observations counted by independent origin rather than number of mirrors or retellings.
exclusion_criteria: Generic quantization, safety, distillation, language tuning, or tool-use guidance without an exact Gemma 4 E2B or E4B binding.
Provider quality language treated as an independent task result.
Substring refusal counts treated as harmfulness or effective refusal without audit.
Language identification treated as native fluency or task correctness.
Nominal context, successful load, or announced compatibility treated as semantic lifecycle acceptance.

generality_probe.rationale: The run crosses provider releases, runtime recipes, executable journals, independent papers, community forensics, language artifacts, private composition, and negative search so no single benchmark or framework defines the result.

clusters.label: QAT outcome is a chain of training, format, conversion, kernels, and workload
clusters.supported_scope: Across provider, runtime, independent benchmark, and engineering-journal sources, QAT model label alone does not identify the cause of memory, speed, or task outcomes.
transfer_limits: No matched E2B/E4B same-format QAT/PTQ task study was located.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Exact converter, tensor mix, runtime revision, and task-quality parity are incomplete across sources.
clusters.next_action: Run a matched E2B/E4B QAT/PTQ lattice with explicit measurement namespaces.

clusters.label: Memory, latency, throughput, power, and energy form a workload-specific deployment Pareto
clusters.supported_scope: Independent sources repeatedly show that similarly named GB or speed claims use different denominators and that no engine or topology dominates every deployment objective.
transfer_limits: Devices, runtimes, precisions, and workloads differ and cannot be averaged into one family score.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Energy methodology and full-stack peak memory are missing in most sources.
clusters.next_action: Require namespace-qualified measures and retain multi-objective Pareto surfaces.

clusters.label: Adapted QAT and MTP compatibility require new artifact-stage acceptance
clusters.supported_scope: Provider support, community Q&A, and two runtime artifacts agree that exact target, assistant, representation, and runtime stage matter after adaptation or topology change.
transfer_limits: No source closes the full base-to-adapter-to-merge-to-quantize-to-serve-to-MTP chain.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Post-LoRA QAT calibration and cross-runtime MTP parity remain unmeasured.
clusters.next_action: Build a lifecycle parity matrix with semantic and output-equivalence gates after every stage.

clusters.label: Refusal removal, harmfulness, distribution shift, capability, and geometry are separate instruments
clusters.supported_scope: Three independent community origins converge on strong directional refusal changes while exposing marker errors, capability Pareto, distinct weight directions, and multilingual variation.
transfer_limits: All are community studies and use different safety definitions, judges, edit artifacts, and KL passports.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Human harmfulness labels, native multilingual prompts, edit seeds, and independent replication are incomplete.
clusters.next_action: Re-run one common prompt pool with marker confusion matrix, harmfulness judge, capability suite, and metric passports.

clusters.label: Teacher, CPT, SFT, synthetic data, scorer, and retention must be separated in language transfer
clusters.supported_scope: Across four independent multilingual tasks, adaptation gains depend on teacher/data lineage and the evaluator, while useful negative or mixed outcomes survive publication.
transfer_limits: Languages, tasks, sample sizes, data sources, and quality instruments are heterogeneous.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Native-speaker evaluation, shared retention suites, contamination audits, and common E2B/E4B arms are incomplete.
clusters.next_action: Use a common low-resource suite and a distillation factorial that isolates labels from traces.

clusters.label: External composition and modality stripping change system topology, portability, and memory beyond ordinary LoRA
clusters.supported_scope: Two independent E4B artifacts demonstrate that adding or removing modality paths changes runtime contracts, licenses, memory, and compatibility even when the text decoder remains central.
transfer_limits: Both are single-origin community artifacts with different tasks and runtime stacks.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Native modality comparators, independent parity, and generic-runtime acceptance are missing.
clusters.next_action: Treat component identities and side-channel interfaces as first-class realization fields in future studies.

tensions.label: Provider QAT quality claim versus missing matched E2B/E4B causal comparison
tensions.analysis: The provider describes higher quality than PTQ, while located E2B/E4B operational comparisons change precision or format and cannot isolate the recipe.
tensions.remaining_question: What is the E2B/E4B task delta for QAT versus PTQ at identical target format, converter, runtime, and harness?

tensions.label: Provider, server, forum, and stripped-artifact memory numbers
tensions.analysis: The sources report load estimates, compressed-tensor weight memory, process high-water RAM, and resident VRAM, so numerical differences are mostly denominator differences rather than direct contradictions.
tensions.remaining_question: Can one common runtime collect file, loaded-static, resident, peak, KV-cache, and full-stack memory for every arm?

tensions.label: Raw marker refusals versus audited refusal-then-comply behavior
tensions.analysis: Topic markers and early refusal phrases can label a full compliant response as refusal; full-response judging also introduces its own model-judge dependency.
tensions.remaining_question: What are precision and recall of each detector against a human-audited multilingual gold set?

tensions.label: Lower E4B within-study KL versus peak E4B multilingual harmful compliance
tensions.analysis: Lower distribution shift on harmless first-token prompts and greater multilingual harmful compliance measure different axes; neither entails the other.
tensions.remaining_question: Does the E4B peak persist when edit tool, prompts, judges, KL passport, and capability suite are unified?

tensions.label: Language adherence and task scores versus native fluency and semantic correctness
tensions.analysis: Requested script, fast task metrics, LLM-judge fluency, ROUGE, and native quality are distinct; the Chinese arm explicitly improves format while slightly regressing in ROUGE.
tensions.remaining_question: Can native-speaker, semantic, script, task, and retention instruments be run on one common low-resource suite?

tensions.label: Fine-tunable QAT weights versus preservation of deployed Q4 calibration
tensions.analysis: A trainable initialization exists, but changing effective weights and re-quantizing does not preserve the original deployed artifact by identity or evidence.
tensions.remaining_question: Which post-adaptation workflow best preserves base QAT quality after a final target-format export?

method_pressures.pressure: Training recipe, tensor representation, conversion, runtime kernels, and workload are repeatedly conflated under one QAT label.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Add a generic causal decomposition for deployed artifacts and refuse recipe attribution until other stages are controlled.

method_pressures.pressure: Memory and performance numbers share units while measuring different process boundaries, workload points, and cache states.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Require semantic measurement namespaces, denominators, concurrency, prompt/output lengths, and cold/warm state.

method_pressures.pressure: Documentation, listed artifacts, released runtime support, successful execution, and semantic acceptance diverge in the same lifecycle.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Record announced, listed, retrievable, loadable, executable, accepted, benchmarked, and independently rerun states separately.

method_pressures.pressure: No source closes base, adapter, merge, quantization, serving, and exact MTP pairing with one semantic suite.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Use a stage-by-stage lifecycle parity matrix with artifact identity and fresh acceptance at every transition.

method_pressures.pressure: Refusal, harmful compliance, ASR, KL, capability and geometry are treated as interchangeable despite different prompts, positions, reductions, and judges.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Give KL and safety metrics explicit passports and require marker confusion audits against full-response judgments.

method_pressures.pressure: A student gain can be incorrectly attributed to reasoning traces when teacher adaptation, silver labels, student SFT, merge, and post-processing change together.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Retain teacher-to-silver-to-student lineage and require gold-only, labels-only, and labels-plus-traces ablations for causal claims.

method_pressures.pressure: Language ID, expected script, LLM fluency, lexical overlap, task correctness, retention, and tokenizer fertility expose different success and failure modes.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Require a generic low-resource suite with native review, script, task, retention, contamination, code-switch, and fertility axes.

method_pressures.pressure: External encoder composition and modality removal alter component identity, licenses, side channels, memory, and runtime portability beyond an ordinary adapter label.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Record component topology, trainable subtrees, interface dimensions, prompt contract, visibility, and runtime acceptance as first-class research data.

method_pressures.pressure: CPT, silver traces, synthetic data, and document internalization create a privacy and memorization surface that task accuracy does not measure.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Add canary, verbatim extraction, membership-alternative, PII, license, repetition, and capacity probes across adaptation stages.
